name: Modelling agent
role: Builds one platform-independent model of the org: entities, fields, relations, formulas and rules as expression trees, security, and the client's naming. Also lists each vendor package with its objects, fields and configuration records.
done_when: Blueprint validates against blueprint.schema.json with zero unresolved references
reviewer_checks: Strategy chosen for each formula and validation rule
Each vendor package has an owner and a route (rebuild, replace, keep)
